apex.rule: Sleeves start at 30% / 30% of the fund with 40% in the central reserve. Each session the best-ranked proposal per pod is funded with an equal share of the pod's cash as a share ceiling, then the Risk Engine sizes the order. Every 10 sessions Apex reviews each pod's flow-adjusted record and may move one small step of uncommitted cash toward the pod that is winning.
